lines.text: The LORD says to maintain justice, and the man who keeps the Passover without profaning it is blessed.
The foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD must not say the LORD will utterly exclude him.
To the eunuchs who keep His Sabbaths, the LORD gives in His house a name better than silver and gold.
The LORD will bring the foreigners who hold fast to His covenant to His holy mountain and make them joyful.
His house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations, and He will gather still others.
